instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Give a community's matchmaker what it asked for: a member's answers and on/off switch, an AI's cited scores for its shortlist, a person's yes or no to an introduction, first topics, or that they wrote in the one-to-one", and give it community_id (The community whose matchmaker runs: its settings are the match-community record of this id.); person; kind.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:answer-in-a-community and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: One answer from one person (person), then the community's clock.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: match-community (records:read); match-member (records:read, records:list, records:write); match-round (records:read, records:list, records:write); match-ask (records:read, records:list, records:write); match (records:read, records:list, records:write); match-answer (records:read, records:list, records:write); ai-job (records:read, records:list, records:write); group (records:read, records:write).
